verdict.rationale: The only event-driven automation in the evidence is the GitHub integration: mentioning /opencode or /oc in a comment triggers tasks in a GitHub Actions runner, set up through a generated workflow. There is also a permission config that rule-based decides whether an action runs automatically, prompts, or is blocked, but that gates actions rather than triggering them. Custom event rules would otherwise need to be built with the SDK or server API. Missing for 10: a native user-defined event/hook system (e.g. on file change, on session or tool events), docs on custom trigger-to-action rules beyond GitHub comment mentions, and independent corroboration of event-driven automation.
